newsitem.title: USA: Art's-Way expects profitable fiscal year.
newsitem.headline: Art's-Way expects profitable fiscal year.

text.p: Art's-Way Manufacturing Co management said Tuesday it believes the company will be profitable for the full fiscal year ending May 31, 1997. In fiscal 1996, it posted a loss of $0.72 per share.
Earlier Tuesday, it reported earnings of $0.01 per share for the August 31 first quarter compared to a year-ago loss of $0.30 per share.
The company manufactures and distributes agricultural related products such as animal feed processing products, sugar beet and potato products and land maintenance equipment.
